claims.claim: Brother SE630 computerized sewing and embroidery machine
claims.evidence: Photos show the Brother brand but no model number; SE630 is not visible
Photo 0 and photo 1 show 'brother' on the front of the machine head

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or stitch correctly
risks.proof: Video of the machine powering on and stitching fabric

risks.risk: Power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, and manuals are missing
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories together
risks.if_unproven: as machine only, with no accessories

risks.risk: Age or year of manufacture is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturing label or serial number

risks.risk: Service history or repairs are unknown

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and stitching
Photo of the model number label
Photo of all accessories including power cord, foot pedal, bobbins, needles, and manuals
Photo of the serial number or manufacturing date label
response.reason: The witness identifies a Brother sewing machine; the seller's Singer claim is contradicted by the photos and the SE630 model is unverified, but the item can be priced at its worst case as a non-working machine without accessories.
